subject: G20
prompt: This intergovernmental forum on the global economy brings together 19 sovereign countries plus two supranational bodies. Which two?
answer: The EU and the African Union
options: The UN and the Arab League
why: The G20 is an intergovernmental forum comprising 19 sovereign countries, the European Union and the African Union, working on issues such as international financial stability and climate change.

subject: Transformers (film series)
prompt: Beginning in 2007 and running through The Last Knight, how many of this science-fiction action series' live-action films did Michael Bay direct?
why: Michael Bay directed the first five live-action Transformers films: Transformers (2007), Revenge of the Fallen (2009), Dark of the Moon (2011), Age of Extinction (2014) and The Last Knight (2017).

subject: Easter
prompt: Also called Pascha or Resurrection Sunday, this festival marks an event the New Testament places how long after the burial?
why: Easter is a Christian festival commemorating the resurrection of Jesus from the dead, described in the New Testament as having occurred on the third day of his burial following his crucifixion.

subject: Argentina national football team
prompt: Administered by the Argentine Football Association, this side is nicknamed la Albiceleste — 'the white and sky blue'. Which country does it represent?
why: The Argentina national football team, nicknamed la Albiceleste, represents Argentina in men's international football and is administered by the Argentine Football Association.

subject: The Lord of the Rings (film series)
prompt: Released between 2001 and 2003 and drawn from Tolkien's three volumes, this epic fantasy trilogy was directed by whom?
why: The Lord of the Rings is a trilogy of epic fantasy films directed by Peter Jackson, based on the novel by J. R. R. Tolkien and taking their titles and plots from its three volumes.

subject: Aadhaar
prompt: Issued by the UIDAI on the basis of residence, biometrics and demographic data, India's voluntary unique identity number has how many digits?
why: Aadhaar is a twelve-digit unique identity number obtainable voluntarily by residents of India based on place of residence, biometrics and demographic data, collected by the Unique Identification Authority of India.

subject: Wikimedia Foundation
prompt: The 501(c)(3) nonprofit best known for hosting Wikipedia is registered as a charitable foundation in which American city?
why: The Wikimedia Foundation is an American 501(c)(3) nonprofit headquartered in San Francisco, California, and registered there as a charitable foundation. It is best known as the host of Wikipedia.

subject: Formula One
prompt: The highest class of open-wheel single-seater racing is run by its own commercial group but sanctioned by which governing body?
why: Formula One is the highest class of worldwide racing for open-wheel single-seater cars, run by the Formula One Group and sanctioned by the Federation Internationale de l'Automobile (FIA).

subject: Bundesliga
prompt: Germany's top football division takes a name that translates literally as what?
why: The Bundesliga, literally 'Federal League', is a professional association football league in Germany and the highest level of the German football system.

subject: Academy Awards
prompt: Commonly called the Oscars, these annual honours for artistic and technical merit in film are presented by which organisation?
why: The Academy Awards, commonly known as the Oscars, are presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) in recognition of artistic and technical merit in film.
